course_name_en: Modelling and Simulation of Mechatronic Systems
prerequisites: Mathematics knowledge at the level of a typical engineering program after the first semester.

learning_outcomes.text: Students possess broad knowledge about modeling, mathematical description, simulation, and properties of systems and signals.
Students have detailed knowledge about the structure and modeling of mechatronic systems. They have an overview of current applications of simulation-based development methods in mechatronics.

Students can model and analyze simple mechatronic systems. They can apply block diagram-oriented simulation tools and consider numerical aspects. They know advanced tools for real-time simulation and their application areas.
Students can present and discuss mechatronic systems and their properties. They can prepare, interpret, and present simulation results.

syllabus_topics: Simulation-supported design of mechatronic systems - Practical and computer exercises
assessment_rules: The graded assessment is either a written project report or an oral project report, chosen by the lecturer. The written project report includes a 5-minute short presentation and a 10-20 page elaboration. The oral project report includes a 15-minute presentation and a 5-10 page elaboration. The ungraded assessment involves approximately 6 experimental exercises.
